fields.asset_name: Kwinana lithium hydroxide refinery (Tianqi Lithium Energy Australia, TLEA)

rows.notes: Production 8,839 t LiOH is for IGO fiscal year ended 30 June 2026 (FY25: 6,782 t); FY27 guidance 9,000-11,000 t; below guidance due to ramp-up problems (100% basis). Capacity = Train 1 only (24,000 t/y design, reported tier from Mining Weekly 2023 snippet); original two-train plan was 48,000 t/y (WA Govt 2019: 'two-stage plant will produce 48,000 tonnes'; source S3 not cited in evidence because it describes the superseded full plan). Train 2 construction suspended Jan 2025 (reported snippet S5). Train 1 was fully impaired by IGO at 30 June 2025 but continues to operate. capacity_ref_year 2025 = date Train 2 suspended (publication-year-style fallback). Installed capacity not separately stated; left null. Capacity confidence lower than production. Greenbushes (spodumene feed) is a separate mining asset. [lead] confidence capped at 0.5: key field rests on reported evidence.

Train 2 placed in care and maintenance in 2024 and construction of Trains 3 and 4 stopped (Albemarle FY2025 release, S6 and same release text 'stopping construction of Kemerton Trains 3 and 4'); remaining operating Train 1 idled / put in care and maintenance on 11 Feb 2026 (S7 electrive; press release reported via Nasdaq/search summaries). So the plant has zero operating trains from Feb 2026: status stays operational (commercial production was reached) with project_state paused. Capacity 50,000 t/y = two built trains x 25,000 (reported tier, search-result summary of the Albemarle announcement; Nasdaq page 503). The 100,000 t/y 4-train plan is cancelled/superseded and not used. capacity_ref_year 2024 = year Trains 3/4 were cancelled. No plant-level production disclosed by Albemarle in sources opened. A Mineral Resources (MinRes) minority stake in the Kemerton asset (task brief mentions Albemarle/MinRes) was NOT verified in any source opened, so jv_partners is left null.

fields.asset_name: Naraha lithium hydroxide plant (Toyotsu Lithium Corporation, TLC)
fields.jv_partners: Arcadium Lithium 75% economic interest, Toyota Tsusho Corporation (TTC) 25%

rows.notes: 10-K FY2024 phrase: '10,000 MT of lithium carbonate to lithium hydroxide capacity at Naraha Plant' (excluded from Arcadium's company-wide total because it is equity-method). Interpreted as 10,000 t/y LiOH (unit 'MT', hydroxide basis not stated: monohydrate assumed per D-102). Ownership: Arcadium holds 49% directly and 75% economic via TLC (S18 and S20: 'Naraha is owned through a joint venture, TLC, with economic ownership of 75% by Arcadium and 25% by TTC.'). Parent after Rio Tinto acquisition not verified. Toyotsu Lithium = Toyota Tsusho entity (name not verified in sources).

Electrek (15 Jan 2026): Tesla video confirms production start; site manager timeline: broke ground 2023, rock through kiln 2024, full integrated startup 2025. Process: kiln, alkaline leach, crystallisation to battery-grade LiOH. NO capacity in tonnes found: secondary web-search results quote ~50 GWh/yr-equivalent and 'over 500,000 EVs/yr' (Argus) vs '1 million vehicles' (Musk/blog) - these are not tonnage and not entered. Electrek says it is unclear whether the plant operates at meaningful capacity. start_year 2025 is the full integrated startup per site manager (kiln run in 2024).
